columns.name: JOB_ID
columns.description: The column indicates a unique sequence generated value.

columns.name: JOB_NAME
columns.description: The column indicates the Job Name

columns.name: JOB_TYPE
columns.description: The column indicates the type of job being triggered.

columns.name: JOB_PROCESS_STATUS
columns.description: The column indicates the process status of the job.

columns.name: JOB_PARAMETERS
columns.description: The column indicates the list of parameters passed as input to the job.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_DATE
columns.description: The column indicates the effective date of the job run.

columns.name: EXPIRY_ID
columns.description: The column indicates the eligibility of the record for purge.

columns.name: ESS_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: The column indicates the process request id for the job.

columns.name: CONFIG_PARAM_GROUP_ID
columns.description: The column indicates the configuration parameters grouped together.

columns.name: OBJECT_ERROR_COUNT
columns.description: The column Indicates the count of objects errored as part of the job.

columns.name: CHUNK_RETRIES
columns.description: The column indicates the number of times the chunk is retried.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of Enterprise, used for multi-tenancy partitioning. Foreign key to HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
